items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: still working with people like Kenny Barron and Toots Thielmans

ctx.x: Okay. So you’ll be doing some commuting from coast to coast?

Yes. I have been commuting. As the old vaudeville joke goes, and my arms are tired. Back and forth. I think it’s seven times since August, back and forth, seven or eight times. So it’ll probably continue maybe five times or so during the next semester. And then of course I’m free from the middle of May until the end of August. So I’ve been doing plenty of other gigs and still working with people like Kenny Barron and Toots © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Thielmans, all during this time, from being there, and have some other projects that I’m involved in. One is a French project that takes me over there a couple of times a year minimum. And I would really like to get my own show back on the road but that’s had to take a back burner by necessity because there’s so much else going on.
